confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer and wine anchors rest on aggregated Córdoba-specific sources (Numbeo-derived figures via Expatica, Córdoba travel guides) and are medium confidence. The cappuccino figure is not Córdoba-specific: it is inferred from Spanish national averages and Andalusian coffee reports, with no Córdoba cappuccino price found. The cocktail and wine anchors are weaker: they come from a single travel site with inconsistent ranges and are cross-checked against Spanish bar-price reports. The EUR-to-USD conversion used a rate of about 1.14 to 1.15. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Córdoba's July demand and the Spanish hostal and hotel market; no booking pages or current listings were inspected, and July is peak season, so rates may vary considerably.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to Andalusian mid-sized Spanish cities with tourism demand similar to Córdoba (Seville and Granada as broad reference points), using Córdoba-specific menú del día and bar-price aggregates where available and national Spanish café and bar averages for the coffee anchor.
